changelog:
oi-divergence v1.0.0

- Initial public release.
- Real-time detection of open interest and price divergence to spot smart money positioning, using data from major exchanges (Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, Hyperliquid).
- Secure, wallet-based pay-per-call access (no account/API key needed); early adopters get automatic 30% discount.
- Simple integration with x402-python client and example response provided.
- Full details on tiered pricing and related signal links included.
summary: Open interest divergence from price — detects smart-money positioning
